project_context.name: Emergent Multi-Agent Orchestrator
project_context.description: An out-of-the-box, rapid, intelligent sorting software and multi-agent orchestrator. Serious, utility-grade tool with zero bloat.

banned_fonts: any monospace font in user-facing UI

strict_rules: NO ALL CAPS. Never use uppercase for titles, buttons, or labels.
Sentence case ONLY for all UI elements (e.g., 'Multi-agent orchestrator dashboard', 'Save changes').
NO MONO FONTS anywhere visible to the user.
Proper grammar and complete sentences must be used everywhere.
No bold underlines or excessively large fonts (max 4xl for hero/dashboard titles).
No synthwave, glitch effects, or neon.
Strictly solid, accessible colors adhering to WCAG AA / APCA standards.

spacing_and_layout.system: USWDS scale (multiples of 8px mapped to Tailwind)
strict_rules: Density should feel like a serious developer console: clean, structured, and utilitarian.

forms.inputs: flat white background, 1px gray border, clean focus state (ring-2 ring-[#005EA2] ring-offset-1)

customization: Use Shadcn components but strip away heavy shadows and rounded pills.
Replace default Vercel-like styling with flat, sharp, USWDS-compliant styles.

key_features: Multi-agent orchestrator dashboard: Cards showing live status of Designer, Coder, QA, and Deployer agents.
File sorter: Drag-and-drop zone for docs, auto-categorization list view.
GitHub repo manager: Repo connection status, file tree view, commit/PR AI logs.
Self-audit panel: Table or log view of AI actions, flagged issues.
Project pipeline: Input area for design specs, linear progress visualizer.
Activity log/console: Clean event stream. No terminal green/black aesthetics—use professional list view.

media_and_images.strategy: Minimal to none. Rely on typography, grid structure, and USWDS iconography for visual interest.

image_urls.description: Minimalist desk for login or empty states, if absolutely necessary.

strict_rules: Use lucide-react icons minimally to support labels, not decorate them.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: You are building a high-grade USWDS utility, NOT a flashy tech startup landing page.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Initialize Tailwind with Public Sans font and the precise USWDS color hex codes.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Enforce 'Sentence case' in all labels and titles. Search your code for ALL CAPS and remove them.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Build a sidebar layout containing the core tools: Dashboard, File sorter, GitHub manager, Audit, Pipeline, Log.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do not include any monospace fonts (e.g., Courier, JetBrains) in the UI styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
